page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.2xlarge is an instance belonging to the Local SSDs family, provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Memory allocation stands at 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing a ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware accelerators are absent, with no GPUs available.

Storage is directly bundled into the instance profile, consisting of a single 1919 GB local solid-state drive (SSD). Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring supplementary routing or Elastic IP assignment for public internet access.

With an elevated 1:8 core-to-memory ratio alongside integrated high-capacity local SSD storage, this configuration delivers substantial resource density for disk-bound and cache-dependent tasks. It is technically suited for transactional relational databases, NoSQL data stores, distributed search indices, and low-latency data processing pipelines.
